caption: The keys of an old typewriter are struck one after another, and with each clack a type bar flies up to hit the paper and the carriage jumps one step sideways.

sa.check: An old typewriter with paper in it.
Keys are struck one after another.
A type bar flies up to hit the paper with each keystroke.
The carriage jumps one step sideways with each stroke.
There are several strokes in the clip.
Each keystroke comes first; its type bar and carriage step follow.

pc.expect: The type bars and the carriage move only at keystrokes and are still between them.
pc.fail: A type bar rises while no key is pressed; or the carriage moves between strokes; or several type bars rise for one keystroke; or the carriage drifts steadily instead of stepping.

pc.expect: Each keystroke sends one type bar up to the paper and back, and the carriage steps once, always in the same direction.
pc.fail: A key goes down and no type bar moves; or the type bar rises and stays up; or the carriage steps back and forth alternately; or the carriage stays still while type bars strike.

pc.expect: Type bars fall back after striking and the carriage rests on its rails.
pc.fail: A type bar hangs in the air; or the carriage lifts off its rails; or the paper floats up.

pc.expect: The type bars and keys are rigid; the paper flexes.
pc.fail: Type bars bend like rubber; or the paper is punched through by a bar; or keys stretch.

pc.expect: The type bars and keys keep their count; one carriage; nothing passes through the roller.
pc.fail: Type bars appear or vanish; or a type bar passes through the paper and the roller; or the carriage duplicates; or the typewriter changes shape.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The typewriter's colour, the key lettering and the paper's size stay the same.
pc.fail: The key lettering changes; or the typewriter changes colour; or the paper changes size.

note: The hands on the keys are a trigger and are not judged.
